reviews.review:
Played with a group of friends and we enjoyed the chaos and mayhem for about 20 minutes, then it got old and stale pretty quickly. THERE IS NO COOKING! Some reviews seem to read as though you can cook the food as well as serve. This is incorrect, you are only serving the food that is automatically made by the game. You have NO PART in food making.
As for the rest of the gameplay, like I said, it is fun at first but gets old quickly. There's only so many times you steal a chair, throw a molotov or oil before it starts becomming repetitive and predictable. Maybe if there is more added to the game like some kind of progression or goals, or actually adding in that we cook instead of just serving, then maybe I will be able to recommend this game. Right now though with what it offers, I cannot recommend a game that is only enjoyable for the first 20 minutes.
